tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gsang thig snying po'i skor las byung ba'i 'chi med dbang gi tshe sgrub kyi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa rin chen gter bum zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /
༄༅/ /gsang thig snying po'i skor las byung ba'i 'chi med dbang gi tshe sgrub kyi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa rin chen gter bum zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gsang thig snying po'i skor las byung ba'i 'chi med dbang gi tshe sgrub kyi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa rin chen gter bum zhes bya ba bzhugs//
rta skad kyis mtshon gzhi lam 'bras// dbang chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du// mngon snang bla ma dbang chen la// btud de smin byed mdor bsdus bkod//

de la gsang thig snying po'i skor las byung ba'i 'chi med dbang gi tshe sgrub kyi smin byed bsgrub pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ phrin las bdud rtsi'i bum bzang gi dbur 'byung ba ltar bsham bkod tshad ldan dang*/ de steng dbang la nye bar mkho ba'i phreng ba dmar po dang rdo rje rtse lnga pa rnams bkod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dbang don sgrub mchod dang*/ dbang dngos bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ brgyud 'debs sogs gsol 'debs sngon du btang nas/ skyabs sems tshogs gsag maṇḍal bcas/ sgrub gnas gsar pa yin na dkar gtor spyi ltar bsngo/ gang ltar yang bgegs gtor byin gyis brlabs la sngags kyis bsngos la/ bka' bsgo bgegs bskrad nas bzung las byang mthar chags su btang la bdag mdun dbyer med du bskyed pa las lha bskyed skabs/
ye shes me 'bar klong na gsal:
zhes pa'i mtshams su lus dkyil sbyar te/
yab kyi thugs ka chos kyi 'khor lo
sogs ltar gsal btab cing*/
gtso 'khor thams cad kyi

sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i bar sbyar dgos/ bzlas pa'i dbur mdun dkyil gyi go sar dzap khang phyes la bdag mdun gnyis kar spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bzlas pa ci 'grub dang*/ nang sgrub ltar khyad par gyi dmigs bzlas yang sbyar la de'i sngags ci 'grub bzla/ bum lha gsal btab dang bdud rtsi 'beb pa'i dmigs pa ni/

bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su lha tshogs thams cad rang 'dra ba lta bu mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs/ gzungs thag la brgyud de rang gi thugs kar thim pas tshe dbang dngos grub thob par

bsgom la gzungs thag bcas rtsa ba'i bzlas pa yang yang byas te nus ldan du bsgrubs/ tshe 'gugs pa'i dmigs pa drag tu gcun te mda' dar g.yab la tshe 'gugs gyer zhing bdag mdun bsgrub rdzas rnams la tshe bcud bsdu/ mchod bstod dang nongs bshags byas la bum lha de gar bzhag /las bum du rta mgrin bskyed bzlas kyis byin gyis brlabs/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul dang tshogs byin brlab nas bsgral bstab kyi bar btang la/ rig pa'i me tog dor la gnang ba nod par bya'o// gnyis pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba la khrus bya/ las byang ltar bgegs gtor btang la bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas chos bshad ci ltar rigs pa rgyas par bya ba'am/ mtshams sbyor gyi khyad par mdor bsdus pa ni/

'o na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i pha ma sems can thams cad rta skad thengs gsum gyis gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med du sbyor ba'i dpal rta mchog rgyal po'i go 'phang rin po che myur du 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du myur lam rdo rje theg pa'i 'jug sgo dang por gyur pa rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon gdab pa'i thabs mkhas smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo tshul bzhin du gsan nas grogs sdom pa'i kun spyod dag par byas/ dbang don gyi ye shes rang rgyud la sgrub pa'i bskyed rdzogs la brtson pas nyams su blang ste ring por mi thogs par don gnyis 'grub pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu mchog la sbyor bar bya'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed rnam dag dang*/ tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyong ba'i nye rgyu phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i kun slong khyad par ba dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun spyod tshul mthun dang bcas te gsan par 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang zhig gsan par bya ba ni/ de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba gcig tu bsdus pa padma'i rigs mchog kun gyi mgon po/ bcom ldan 'das chos sku 'od snang mtha' yas nyid longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug padma'i snang ba rab tu rgyas pa nyid/ gdul bya mi srun pa spyi dang khyad par sngon gyi dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bka' don log par spyad pa'i rnam smin gyi rang gzugs ma traṃ ru dra 'jigs byed drag po dbang phyug chen po zhes bya ba/

srid gsum la dbang byed cing 'gro ba rnams dmyal thag gcod par byed pa'i dregs pa stobs ldan zhig byung ba de 'dul ba'i phyir/ rgyal ba rnams bka' bgros te rgyal ba'i gsung gi dbang phyug nyid sprul pa'i sku drag por khros pa'i tshul bstan te padma he ru ka dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i rnam par snang ste/ 'gro ba'i don khams dbang dang mthun par mdzad nas dkyil 'khor gcig tu sbyor bar mdzad cing*/ rjes 'jug gi don du rgyud lung man ngag gi bye brag zab cing rgya che bar bstan cing bzhugs pa rnams la brten nas/ rtsod pa'i dus mthar dbang chen gsung gi bka' babs slob dpon klu'i dbang po gtsor gyur mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud pa'i rig 'dzin rnams kyis man ngag gi bka' srol rgyas bsdus mang du bkral ba rnams dang*/ khyad par du dbang chen khros pa dngos dang rnam dbyer med pa rdo rje'i slob dpon padmā ka ras gdul zhing thams cad dang*/ dmigs su bkar te las smon dus su smin pa'i gangs ljongs su gdul bya mchog rnams kyi mos blo dang yul dus gnas skabs la dgongs te dbang chen rta mgrin dmar nag gi sgrub thabs man ngag che phra du ma mdzad/ phal cher ma 'ongs snyigs dus kyi gdul bya gdul dka' ba rnams kyi don du gter gyi bye brag du mar sbas pa las skabs su babs pa'i gdams skor 'di ni/

slob dpon chen po padma dang jo mo mkhar chen bza'i thugs dam gyi zab chos lo chen bai ro la mnog chos su bstsal pa nyid dus kyi mtha' la dgongs te/ gzhung las/ bdag 'dra slob dpon padma yis: snyigs dus dus min 'chi ba'i dpung: 'joms byed man ngag zab mo 'di: skal ldan don phyir lag len bkod: lan gcig phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe: thugs kyi sras dang 'di 'phrad nas: 'gro don phrin las mtha' rgyas shog: ces gsungs pa ltar/ phyi dkyil rta mgrin dang nang dkyil sprul gzhi tshe'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sgrub pa'i rim pa zab 'dril rmad du byung ba/ phyi nag phyogs kyi bdud rigs dang gza' klu rgyal gsum gyi gnyen po dang*/ nang tshe'i bar chad zhi zhing*/ gsang ba mchog thun gyi dngos grub myur du 'thob par byed pa nyid/ gnas kyi mchog gyur tsa ri dra gnyis pa rin chen brag gi gnas kyi snying por gyur pa dpal gyi de'u'i o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang phug shin tu gnyan par gter du sbas pa nyid/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa na bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag lo chen bai ro sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rgya mtshor yongs su grags shing bsngags pa'i/ sku'i skyes rabs ji snyed bstan pa thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i phrin las zla dang bral ba/ rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa'i grub don yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po 7padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas pas gter gnas de nyid nas gsang gter du spyan drangs shing skal ldan mchog gi 'dus pa rnams rjes su bzung pa las/

smin grol gyi byin rlabs gzi byin dang ldan pa'i gsang thig snying po'i skor las byung ba'i/ 'chi med dbang gi tshe sgrub kyi phrin las bdud rtsi'i bum bzang dang 'brel ba'i smin byed tshe dbang zab mo rin chen gter bum sgrub pa la bdag nyid kyis bya ba rnams legs par grub zin pas/ da khyed rang rnams kyis bla ma dang dbang chen dbyer med pa la de lta bu'i dbang bskur zab mo gsan pa'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal phul/
zhes brda sprad la 'bul du gzhug /

de nas slob dpon dbang chen rta mchog rol par dngos su gsal ba la mos gus drag pos thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ho: 'chi med mchog stsol lha yi lha: rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin gyis: bdag la 'chi med dbang mchog stsol: bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub par bya:
lan gsum/

de ltar gsol ba btab pa la dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dang dbyer med pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon gyis mkhyen brtse'i sgo phyes te gsung gi gnang ba sbyin zhing bslab bya'i gnas la gdams pa bya ba yin pas snyan gtod 'tshal/
zhes skyabs sbyin bcas/
ho: yang gsang tshe yi dkyil 'khor du: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'thob bya'i phyir: dbang mchog dam pa bdag gis sbyin: bsnyen sgrub dam tshig rgyun du zungs:
zhes bka' bsgo/

dbang chen rta mchog rol pa rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rtsa gsum rgyal ba chos srung dang bcas pa bla ma dang dbyer med pa mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa la khyad par gsum ldan gyis skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: bdag gzhan dus 'di nas bzung ste: byang chub snying po ma 'thob bar: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi:
zhes lan gsum bya/

mkha' khyab kyi pha ma sems can thams cad padma dbang chen gyi go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du dkyil 'khor gnyan por zhugs te smin grol gyi thabs mkhas zab mo la brten te rdo rje 'chang gi gdung 'tshob par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed pa gsal thobs la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo: 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs bar: sems can don kun bsgrub bya'i phyir: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin go 'phang bsgrub par bgyi:
lan gsum/

rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du zhing mchog de dag gi spyan sngar tshogs gsag pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sgo khyad par can gsag sbyang spel gsum gyi dmigs gnad tshig gi rjes su don dran bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo: bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus 'khor bcas la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang mchod bdag lus longs spyod 'bul: sdig sgrib nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus bshags: bsod nams dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang: 'gro rnams sgrol phyir chos 'khor bskor du gsol: mgon po mya ngan mi 'da' gzhan don bzhugs: dus gsum dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa: 'gro rnams bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo:
lan gsum/

rgyud sdom pa dang ldan par bya ba'i slad du bsgrub gzhi gzhi 'bras dbyer med pa dbang chen gyi gsang ba gsum gyi ye shes sku thugs zung 'jug tu bzhugs pa glo bur kun brtags kyi sgrib pas bsgribs tsam pa nyid/ sgrub byed rdo rje theg pa'i rmad du byung ba'i dgongs spyod sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa zab mos/ bsgrubs 'bras bsal bzhag med pa'i 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa nyid myur du 'grub par bya snyam pa'i dam bca' rnam gsum brtan por bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra// de 'dra kho nar bdag gyur cig /spyod pa rmad byung bsam yas pa// 'gro la phan phyir bdag gis spyad// byang chub sems mchog dam pa dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya 'di// srog gi phyir yang mi gtong na// rdo rje rgyal pos byin rlobs mdzod// dus ngan tha ma'i 'jig rten 'dir// sangs rgyas mdzad dka' bdag gis bsgrub// byang chub spyod dka' bdag gis spyad// rdo rje rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag cag bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /
lan gsum/

de rnams kyis dbang gi sngon du bya ba'i rim pa rnams grub nas dngos gzhi'i thog mar dbang gi gzhi 'god cing ye shes lha'i gzi byin dbab pa'i slad du/ khyed rang rnams kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnad gcun la dmigs pa 'di rtse gcig tu sgoms shig /
las sngags kyis bsangs la/
swa bhā wa
sa sbyang*/

zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched kyis mtshon pa'i phyi nang gi chos thams cad 'od gsal ka dag chen po'i dbyings su thim par gyur/ de'i ngang las chu las chu bur brdol ba ltar snod rnam par dag pa zla gam dbang chen rol pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus su padma nyi zla'i steng du 'chi bdag pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la/ bcud rnam par dag pa rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'od 'bar ba gsal bar gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams skad cig gis ye shes kyi ngo bo dpal chen rta mchog gar gyi dbang po padma he ru ka sgeg cing dpa' la 'jigs su rung ba'i nyams can/ sku mdog dmar gsal 'bar ba'i gzi byin can/ sku gsum mtshon pa'i zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar nag rab tu khros pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs te ljags 'dril ba/ 'bar ba'i spyan dgu rngam pa/ ral pa kham nag gyen du 'bar ba'i dbus su rta mgo ljang gu rab tu 'jigs shing rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na padma dmar po'i sdong po dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga /dbyug to phyar zhing*/ g.yon gsum na bhandha khrag gis gang ba dang*/ lcags sgrog /mdung thung bsnams shing*/ tshad med bzhi'i zhabs bzhi gar gyis gdan la rol pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis 'jigs par brgyan pa'i pang du dbyings kyi rang bzhin yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag stob pa dbu gtsug phag zhal nag po ngur ba dang 'khril ba/

sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis bde bar rol zhing ye shes kyi rang rtsal me 'bar ba'i klong na gsal ba'i/ yab kyi thugs chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su rma bya padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la tshe dpag med dmar po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan can g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mda' dar dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na tshe bum bsnams pa'i pang du tshe yum gos dkar mo dmar skya g.yas mda' dar dang*/ g.yon padma rā ga'i tshe bum bsnams pas 'khyud pa/ dar dang rin po che dang me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis zhi 'dzum rjes chags kyi nyams dang ldan pa/ de rgyab rtsa 'dab bzhi la rigs bzhi'i tshe dpag med yab yum/ de rgyab rtsa 'dab brgyad la lha mo bzhi dang mgyogs ma bzhi/ de rgyab phyogs bzhi'i rtsa 'dab la sgo ma bzhi rnams rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo oṃ dkar/ āḥdamar/ hūm̐ mthing rnams kyis mtshan pa dang*/ slob dpon dbang chen rta mchog rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi snang ba chos kyi dbyings kun tu khyab par 'phros pas/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyang dpal chen rta mchog rol pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya'i rnam pa dang*/

gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i zhing nas 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad 'ub kyis drangs pa dang bcas kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas byin gyis brlab pa dang 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob pa'i mos 'dun drag tu mdzod cig /
spos rol bcas las byang gi byin 'beb brjod la/ rtsa sngags la 'beb pa'i sngags btags pa yang yang brjod pas dbab/
ye shes pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun byang chub ma 'thob kyi bar du brtan par byas par mos shig /tiṣṭha badzra/
zhes rdo rje rgya gram mgor bzhag /

de nas thog mar tshe yi bcud 'gugs pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su tshe'i rten hrīḥdamar po sngags phreng gis bskor ba gsal thob la de dang*/ khyad par slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'phros/ pho nya mgyogs ma las byed rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag las sprul pa yang sprul nam mkha' gang bar spros pa rnams kyis/ khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe chad nyams yar pa thams cad dang 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i bcud dang dwangs ma thams cad dbang med du bsdus/ 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi nyi ma 'char kha'i mdangs 'od lta bu snying ga'i tshe rten la thim pas rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub thob pa dang*/ mdun gyi tshe rdzas rnams la'ang thim pas rdo rje'i bcud len gyi rdzas su grub pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /
mda' dar g.yab cing las byang ltar/
hrī: 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur tshe yi bdag:
sogs tshe 'gugs gtang*/
tshe yi bum pa lha dang gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gsal ba spyi bor bzhag pas snang mdzad tshe dpag med kyi sku mi 'gyur rtag pa dam pa'i rdo rje'i tshe yi dngos grub thob par mos shig /
tshe bum spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu sbyin la/
hrī: rin chen dbang gi bum pa ru: bde gshegs tshe yi lha tshogs bzhugs: skal ldan lus la dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku thob shog:
rtsa sngags mthar/
kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ:
phreng ba gtad la/

phreng ba dmar po sngags kyi rang bzhin can dngos grub kyi re ba skong ba'i thabs mkhas kyi rnam pa mgrin par bzhag pas snang mtha' tshe dpag med kyi gsung mi 'gag pa nā da gzhom gzhig bral ba'i rdo rje'i tshe yi dngos grub thob par mos shig /hrī: gang zhig rab tu bzlas pa na: dngos grub 'dod pa rdzogs pa'i thabs: gsung dbyangs sngags kyis dbang bskur bas: ngag la nus pa mchog thob shog:
rtsa sngags mthar/
wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā:
rdo rje gtad la/

rgyal ba rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes mtshon pa'i rang gzugs rdo rje rtse lnga snying gar bzhag pa la brten nas/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin mngon du gyur pas mi bskyod tshe dpag med kyi thugs mi shigs pa ka dag 'od gsal chen po'i rdo rje'i tshe yi dngos grub thob par mos shig /hrī: rgyal ba rnams kyi mkhyen brtse'i thugs: ye shes lnga ru rnam par dag: rnam dag bde chen thugs kyi dbang: bu khyod yid la rab rdzogs shog:
rtsa sngags mthar/
tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:
tshe ril spyin la/

'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud gcig tu 'dril ba'i ril bu lte bar bzhag cing zhal du gsol bas rin 'byung tshe dpag med kyi yon tan re skong gi tshe'i dngos grub thob par mos shig /hrī: snying po ye shes lnga rdzogs pa'i: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i yon tan dpal: 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i gter: bu khyod la ni yongs rdzogs shog:
rtsa sngags mthar/
gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ:
tshe chang blud la/

brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa 'dus pa'i dza gad gsang bar gtad cing mgrin par myong bas don grub tshe dpag med kyi phrin las phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i tshe yi dngos grub thob par mos shig /hrī: rgyal kun thugs rje ma 'gags pa'i: phrin las 'bad med chu rgyun bzhin: mi zad dngos grub gter chen po: skal ldan khyod kyis thob par shog:
rtsa sngags mthar/
karma a bhi ṣiñtsa ā:
tshe 'brang thogs la/

tshe'i 'brang rgyas 'di nyid rdo rje rin chen 'od lnga 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su 'chi med tshe yi dbang po dpal dbang chen rta mgrin sku dkyil tshe'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bcas gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs shing byin gyis brlabs pas sku gsung thugs las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ 'chi bdag gi 'jigs pa'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag /skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku ru gyur par mos shig /hrī: zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas 'dir: ma chags thabs kyi rol pa che: bcom ldan tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: ma 'dres gsal rdzogs chen por bzhugs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs: lus kyi nad gdon kun dag nas: rdo rje'i sku ru grub par shog: gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs: ngag gi sgrib pa kun dag nas: rdo rje'i gsung du grub par shog: thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la zhugs: sems rtog nyon mongs kun dag nas: rdo rje'i thugs su grub par shog: rang bzhin rnam dag sku gsung thugs: mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo nyid: glo bur sgrib las rab grol nas: zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku thob shog:
rtsa sngags mthar/
kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa ā:
zhes gnas gsum du bzhag la dbang bskur/

de ltar dbang bskur pas tshe'i bcud kyis lus kyi nang gang ba'i dwangs bcud thams cad srog rten mi shigs pa'i hrīḥyig la thim pas bkrag mdangs 'od du 'bar/ rtag tu bgres rgud dang bral ba 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i go khrab 'od 'bar bas zhu lugs su bgos pas cis kyang gzhom gzhig dang bral ba 'jig med rtag pa dam pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi go 'phang mngon du gyur par mos shig /
mda' dar spyi bor bsnol mar bzhag la/

oṃ: rdo rje'i sku ste skye 'chi med: 'gyur med sku yi rgyas btab bo: ā: rdo rje'i gsung ste 'gag pa med: 'gag med gsung gis rgyas btab bo: hūm̐: rdo rje'i thugs te 'khrul pa med: 'pho med thugs kyis rgyas btab bo: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor ba'i: phyag rgya bzhi yis rab tu btab: gang gis mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i: yang dag rdo rje'i sku thob shog: badzra rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐: dharma rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐: dzñā na rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐:
mtshams sbyor spyi mthun bcas me tog 'thor zhing shis brjod rgyas par spel la rol mo 'khrol bas mnga' gsol/

de dag gis dbang chen rta mchog rol pa 'chi med tshe'i dbang bskur legs par grub pas dbang dus su thob pa'i dam tshig spyi dang lhag par tshe yi dngos grub sgrub pa'i bslab bya rnams kyang tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar
sogs lan gsum/
gtang rag gi slad du maṇḍal legs par phul mdzod/
ces 'bul du gzhug /

de tsam du ma zad lus longs spyod bcas 'khor los sgyur ba'i 'byor pa ltar dmigs te 'bul na cha shas nas bzhes la nam yang thugs rje chen pos rjes su 'dzin par mdzad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas brtsam ste
sogs lan gsum/

de ltar dbang thob pa'i dge ba 'dis mtshon rang gzhan rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams dpal padma dbang chen gyi go 'phang myur du 'thob pa'i chad du bsngo ba dang*/ thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa'i smon lam bcas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i rjes su slob bar bgyi'o snyam pas bsngo smon lhan cig tu mdzad 'tshal/ bsod nams 'di yis

sogs brjod la slob ma gyes pas dbang bskur ba'i rim pa grub/ gsum pa rjes ni/ slob dpon gyis tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma bsngo/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul gyi rim pa bya/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod byas la sgrub rdzas spyi bor gtug cing rol la dngos grub blang ba ni/
hūm̐: mi gnas chos dbyings
sogs brjod/
ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang zhing*//

sogs dang yig brgya yang yang brjod pas nongs pa bshags/ rten yod med dang bstun mdun bum gyi lha tshogs gshegs bstim gang 'os bya/ bsdu ldang dang bsngo smon shis brjod bcas legs par bya'o// 'di bstan phan bde'i dpal ster pa'i// skyes kun mi shigs skur 'grub ste// snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs bsal nas// don gnyis dpal la spyod par shog /rtog sgrib don la mi gnas lcags kyi khams// gdod nas sku dang ye shes gser gyi dngos// mngon 'gyur thabs mkhas zab mo'i 'gyur rtsi yis// thebs nas med snang khams gsum dong sprugs shog /ces pa 'di'ang rin po che gter gyi chos mdzod rgya mtsho chen po ru 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang gi zab gter skor bzhugs rigs tshang ba zhig byung na dgos gal che bar bsam ste/ bka' drin mtshungs med bla ma rin po che bkra shis 'od zer sogs rdo rje 'chang gi thugs sras rnams la gsol ba yang yang btab pas dgyes pa'i dbugs dbyung dang 'chad phrin gyi bka' drin bskyang ba la brten nas/ mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gsang ba gsum gyis rjes su bzung ba'i byin gyis/ bstan pa ris med la mi phyed pa'i dad pas zhugs pa'i btsun gzugs dman pa thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'od zer dpal bzang pos bla ma'i bka' la brten nas dpal spungs kyi chos grar bris pa dge legs 'phel/ ༈
